cause_quote: The native row changed from `Text(self.display.title)` to `Text(self.item.activity?.title ?? self.display.title)`, giving the Gateway's `${label} — outcome unknown` fallback precedence over the local title.
user_saw: An expanded native chat step showed “Exec — outcome unknown” in place of its local tool title when the Gateway had no terminal status.
summary: The fix restores the local title for ended tool steps without a terminal status and keeps a visible “No result” cue on iPhone.
reasoning: I checked the causing commit's parent and confirmed that the existing native row resolved its displayed title from the tool name and arguments, including for calls without a result. The causing diff added the Gateway's unknown-outcome title and made the same row prefer it, breaking the existing local-title behavior.
